ErrorCode.description:
The code of an [`ErrorBody`] (snake_case on the wire). Command PRs add their own refusal
codes here.

oneOf.description: 421: the `Host` header or the absolute-form authority is not the daemon's.
403: the `Origin` header breaks the route's rule.
403: the token's kind or grant does not allow the action or object.
404: no such route, command, or object, or one the token cannot read.
405, with `Allow`.
400: framing, a handshake, or a body that is not the route's.
400: the query string.
400: the command arguments.
409: the command's receipt is still `in_progress`.
409: the `command_id` belongs to another token or another request.
409: the command's receipt was `in_progress` when the daemon restarted.
501: the route's or command's handler has not been implemented yet.
503: a bounded resource is taken; retry after `retry_after`.
503: the daemon is stopping.
503: the store refused writes after a fatal error.
503: the write's outcome is not known; retry with the same `command_id`.
409: resume or close of a closed thread.
409: the expected launch is not the thread's current launch.
409: resume or close (without `stop`) while the current launch has not exited.
409: the current launch exited without confirmed death.
409: the launch's worktree is not `active` or `released`.
409: resume of a thread with no bound session.
400: the input encoders' check refused the positional prompt.
400: the prompt exceeds `MAX_PROMPT_BYTES`.
504: a stop could not take its launch and re-read it in time; nothing changed.
409: the thread's current launch is not live for `send`, `ready`, or `key`.
409: `ready` for a launch with no bound session.
409: a card key whose card is not open in the launch.
409: the key unit wrote zero bytes; a retry may succeed.
409: `input_resolve` of an input not `unconfirmed`, `input_cancel` of one not `queued`.
409: `ready` while an input unit of the launch may still write.

description:
The body of every rejection the daemon decides. `retry_after` is whole seconds and
absent (never `null`) when not given.
title: ErrorBody
